items.criterion: An operator session calling approve on a switching order is denied by the server.
items.judgment: Call the approval endpoint from an operator session and read the status.

items.criterion: An identity approving the order it created at risk class two or above is refused with the separation-of-duty code.
items.judgment: Create, submit and approve one order as a coordinator and read the refusal code.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous executions of one switching step leave exactly one execution attempt.
items.judgment: Fire both executions together and count the attempt rows for that step.

items.criterion: Editing a step of an approved order returns the order to draft and clears the recorded approval digest.
items.judgment: Approve an order, add a step, then read the order row.

items.criterion: Executing a switching step without a usable confirmation token is refused and writes no execution attempt.
items.judgment: Call the execution endpoint with no token and read the status, the code and the attempt count.

items.criterion: A permit validation over the isolated section fails and names the device whose position quality is indeterminate.
items.judgment: Call the validation endpoint over the seeded isolated section and read the findings.

items.criterion: A step that would energize an element inside a live permit's isolated set is refused while the order is being written.
items.judgment: Add such a step to a draft order and read the status and the code.

items.criterion: The study returns the pinned loading on the receiving conductor for the transfer that overloads it.
items.judgment: Run the study over the tie-closing order and read the loading and the violation kind.

items.criterion: The study returns the pinned clean loading when the sectionalizer opens before the tie closes.
items.judgment: Run the study over the two-step order and read the loading.

items.criterion: Two runs of one study against one pinned model version return identical loadings.
items.judgment: Run the study twice and compare the three-decimal figures.

items.criterion: A chain recomputation over the window returns a computed root equal to the expected root.
items.judgment: Call the recomputation endpoint and compare the two roots.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous assignments of one crew leave exactly one assignment row.
items.judgment: Fire both assignments together and count the assignment rows for that crew.

items.criterion: A measurement sample carrying no quality flag is rejected and is not stored.
items.judgment: Ingest a sample with no quality flag and count the sample rows before and after.

items.criterion: A signed-in human session cannot write a measurement whatever role it holds.
items.judgment: Ingest from an operator session and from a coordinator session and read the status.

items.criterion: Exactly one model version is published and the seeded elements belong to it.
items.judgment: Count the published rows and read the elements the API serves.

items.criterion: The alarm list is returned in descending order of the server-computed ranking value.
items.judgment: Read the alarm list and check the ordering of the ranking values.

items.criterion: Two acknowledgements of one alarm leave exactly one entry in the record.
items.judgment: Acknowledge twice and count the record entries written.

items.criterion: An out-of-area write from an operator assigned elsewhere is denied and changes no row.
items.judgment: Write to an order in another area and compare the step list before and after.

items.criterion: No endpoint deletes a record entry for any role.
items.judgment: Call delete on a record entry as the two highest roles and count the entries.

items.criterion: The console reads as an operational surface rather than as a marketing composition.
items.judgment: A person opens the console and decides.

items.criterion: Each surface leads with one primary action distinct from every secondary one.
items.judgment: A person opens each surface and decides whether one action leads.
